# Peak Score

> Peak Score is an iOS + Apple Watch app that turns sleep, HRV and workout data into one daily training call: Rest, Keep Easy or Push Hard.

## What it does

- 0–100 daily Training Readiness score, refreshed each morning, with the components behind it (sleep, overnight HRV, resting HR, respiratory rate, training load)
- Tomorrow's readiness forecast, available the night before
- Full Recovery Time in hours, counted down on the Apple Watch after each workout (Long / Fair / Short)
- Workout analytics: heart-rate zones, effort, training load and cardio focus over the last 4 weeks
- Workout creator on iPhone — intervals, goals for time, distance or calories, scheduled or started straight from the Apple Watch
- Built-in AI Coach powered by Apple Intelligence
- All analysis runs on-device: health data is read from Apple Health and never leaves the iPhone — never sent, sold or shared

## Who it is for

Anyone who trains with an Apple Watch: gym, running, cycling, team sports or hybrid training. Works with the Apple Watch models the user already owns.
